name: Windows 11 Taskbar for Windows 10
description: Restyle Windows 10 taskbar to match Windows 11 design. Features centered icons, modern UI, blur effect, search integration, and Windows 11 visual polish.
author: MOLYN DEVELOPMENT

settings.name: Center taskbar icons
settings.description: Position taskbar icons in the center (Windows 11 style) instead of left-aligned

settings.name: Modern icon spacing
settings.description: Apply larger padding and spacing between icons for modern look

settings.name: Rounded corners
settings.description: Enable rounded corners on taskbar and icon buttons

settings.name: Blur/Glass effect
settings.description: Enable Aero blur effect behind taskbar (Mica-like appearance)

settings.name: Dark mode
settings.description: Use dark theme colors (requires Windows 10 dark mode enabled)

settings.name: Corner radius (px)
settings.description: Radius of rounded corners in pixels

settings.name: Accent color
settings.description: Accent color for highlights and active items (hex: #RRGGBB)

settings.name: Show widgets button
settings.description: Add Windows 11-style widgets button to taskbar

settings.name: Show integrated search
settings.description: Add modern search box to taskbar

settings.name: Smooth animations
settings.description: Enable smooth transitions for hover/click effects
